title: Greedy Best-First in Nairobi: Faster Streets!
description: Watch Greedy Best-First race across a real street-like grid to reach a destination fast. It prioritizes the most promising intersection using only the heuristic, trading guaranteed shortest paths for speed.
ig_caption:
🧭✨ Nairobi (Westlands) street map, but make it algorithmic.

In this visualization, **Greedy Best-First** always expands the node with the *lowest heuristic* (think: closest-looking next intersection) toward the goal—no g-cost accumulation, just a bold guess guided by distance estimates. 📍🤖

From a graph theory lens, your street map becomes a **weighted graph (intersections = vertices, roads = edges)**. Even if edge weights vary (traffic/road length), Greedy Best-First focuses on **h(n)** (estimated cost to goal) to pull the search toward likely routes—fast convergence, but it may miss the true shortest path. ⚡️📉

Want to see your city next? Drop your neighborhood in the comments and hit follow for more real-map pathfinding demos! 👇🚦
